technical_and_design_decisions: Target system context is assumed to be Spring XD / Spring Integration ecosystem built on Java 8/17 and Maven/Gradle dependency management.

For U1, the custom DLQ capability will be implemented via an extended message handler interceptor/error handler that captures the Throwable instance, serializes the stack trace into a standard header (x-exception-stacktrace), and routes to a configured alternate destination.

For U2, the OOTB CDC (Change Data Capture) module will leverage a standard database polling/log-listener adapter architecture capable of publishing change event payloads to Spring Cloud Stream / Spring XD message channels.
For U3, RabbitMQ HA/FT support will be added by updating Spring AMQP ConnectionFactory configuration to accept multi-host connection strings and standard HA queue arguments.

For U5, module colocation will use in-memory local messaging channels (e.g., DirectChannel/QueueChannel) when modules reside in the same container instance, and ZooKeeper/Curator leader election will be integrated for automated stream failover.
assumptions: Upstream releases (Gemfire 8.1, Spring Data Gosling GA, SI Milestone/GA) are available and accessible in accessible Maven repositories.
Development work includes unit testing, module-level integration testing, and documentation updates for updated configuration properties.
All work is carried out by a single experienced senior Java/Spring software engineer.
Environment provisioning for external middleware (RabbitMQ cluster, Gemfire, Kafka, database systems) for testing is available or scripted via containers.

activities.activity_description: Analyze technical requirements, design CDC event streaming module structure, establish leader election pattern for colocated stream modules, and plan multi-dependency upgrade matrix.

activities.activity_name: Alternative DLQ and Exception Headers Implementation (U1)
activities.activity_description: Implement configuration properties for custom DLQ target, construct exception payload header enrichment (exception type, message, full stack trace), and add unit/integration tests.

activities.activity_name: OOTB Database Change Stream Module Implementation (U2)
activities.activity_description: Develop OOTB CDC module to ingest database changes as streams, format events, and support routing to various stream sinks (Brokers, Hadoop, DBs).
Enhance RabbitMQ connection management to support cluster addresses, failover policies, and native HA queue options within Spring AMQP integration.
Update project dependencies to Gemfire 8.1 and Spring Data Gosling GA, refactor broken APIs, and update affected data store modules.
Implement local channel transport for colocated modules within the same container, and build leader election mechanisms for stream failover between containers.
Upgrade Spring Integration framework version, resolve API compatibility changes, and sync JMX monitoring and management improvements.
Upgrade Spring Integration Kafka library, adapt messaging templates and inbound/outbound adapters to the updated Kafka client APIs.
Update pom.xml dependency versions (Logback, Jackson, Tomcat, Jetty, Elasticsearch, Spring Security, etc.) to match Spring Boot 1.2.3 BOM, resolving compile and runtime conflicts.

activities.activity_name: End-to-End Integration Testing & Regression Suite Execution
activities.activity_description: Perform full system integration testing across upgraded dependencies, verify failover scenarios, verify CDC streams, and fix identified regression issues.
